info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Procurement Management API
info.description: The Procurement Management API enables businesses to enhance and modify their procurement processes efficiently. Through this API, users can update procurement details, manage supplier relationships, and streamline approval workflows. Targeted primarily at procurement departments and finance teams, this API supports use cases such as adjusting order quantities, changing delivery schedules, and revising pricing agreements. It provides a robust interface for integrating procurement activities into enterprise workflows while ensuring accuracy and compliance.
